## Registration and access rights {#registration-and-access-rights .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

ME Partner Download Space is a source of data you require to work with RC. The following instructions explain how to obtain access to the data you need.

1\. Contact your Rexroth representative in case the access to Collaboration Rooms at myRexroth has not been granted to you yet.

2\. Start your registration at [https://www.boschrexroth.com](https://www.boschrexroth.com){.weblink target="_blank"} \> myRexroth \> Login.

2\. Use your company email and your newly created password to login to myRexroth homepage.

3\. After you successfully logged in, you can view ME Partner Download Space.

See video [myRexroth Onboarding](https://media.video.bosch.com/media/Hello+World+Rexroth+Controllers+Series+40+++myRexroth+Onboarding/0_xdifrzn7){.weblink target="_blank"} for a step-by-step instruction on the registration for myRexroth.

## Project structure {#project-structure .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Create the following directories on your PC to organize your project properly:

1\. C:\\Tools

2\. C:\\Tools\\Compiler

3\. C:\\Projekte

4\. C:\\Projekte\\HelloWorld

## Example project {#example-project .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

ME Partner Download Space provides project examples, which you can use to start working with your RC. Choose the folder corresponding to your RC and download it.

1\. Go to ME Partner Download Space \> 20_Engineering Tools \> 00_Support Training \> RC40_HelloWorld \> 03_Examples

2\. Choose the example corresponding to your RC, download and save it to C:\\Projekte\\HelloWorld

3\. Extract the zip file to C:\\Projekte\\HelloWorld

4\. Additionally, follow the same procedure as above for the ServiceApps_HelloWorld file located in 03_Examples.

Your unpacked sample project has the following structure:

  Folder name   Description
  ------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------
  \_dbs         Files for import to easyConfig or diagnosis.
  \_udsImport   Files for import of UDS configurations (DIDs & DTCs) to easyConfig
  Asw           An example of Application SW defined for HelloWorld project
  Bsw           An example of Basic SW
  Release       Hex-file ready for flashing.
